title: Charles K NDE 13106
content: Whenever someone asks me if I believe in life after death, I share this story with them: On a Friday, April 14, 2023, after being diagnosed with Wildon's disease. This disease caused fourth degree cirrhosis of the liver. On my way home from an appointment with my doctor, my wife left me for about twenty minutes to pick up our kids from school. When she came back, my oldest daughter was greeting me. I motioned for her to turn on the fan and then passed away. It was like a light wind that carried me into a deep sleep in a far away country. I was attracted by this bright light, and freed from all pain. I was full of light in the new body and I refused to go back. I ran to catch up to the enigmatic character whose face I could not see because of the brilliance. This character did not want me to stay too long in this country. At one point, I was almost close to Him. He blew and under the breath, it was like a big hand pushed me. With a crash, I woke up and saw many people at home. My wife was at my feet. She prayed and thought that I was sleeping. I began by asking people questions such as how long they had been there? Almost unanimously, they answered 'almost an hour.' I began to tell them with tears, how long I had been gone and I did not want to go back there. If it was not this violent breath from this mysterious character who pushed me. From then on, I realized that the distance from this life to the next life is infinitely small. The enjoyment of the next life is in no way comparable to what we call Happiness here below. It is more than a privilege to love and to forgive as much as we can because we may never have this opportunity. Four (4) months later, on August 28, 2023, I had a liver surgery and I am living wonderfully well after the liver transplant. Glory to Yeshua Amashia Kuhmama and thank you to the Doctors and thé donor's family A chaque fois que quelqu'un me pose la question si je crois en une vie après la mort, je leur partage cette histoire: Un Vendredi 14 Avril 2023, après avoir diagnostiqué de la maladie de Wildon qui a causé un cirrhose du foie au quatrième degré, en rentrant chez moi après un rendez-vous avec mon médecin, ma femme m'a laissé pendant une vingtaine de minutes pour aller chercher nos enfants à l'ecole quand soudain, elle revenait et ma fille ainée me saluait et, le je lui ai fait signe d'allumer le ventilateur et je trepassais. C'était comme un vent leger qui m'emportait dans un sommeil profond dans un pays lointain et très lointain... Attiré par cette lumière eclatante, et libéré de toutes douleurs et leger dans le nouveau corps, je refusais de revenir en arrière, et courrais pour rattraper les grandes enjambées d'un personnage enigmatique dont je ne pouvais voir le visage a cause de la brillance. Lequel personnage ne voulais pas que je restais trop dans ce pays. A un moment donné j'étais presque près de Lui quand iL souffla et sous souffle comme une grosse main me poussait avec fracas je me reveillais et voir beaucoup de personnes à la maison et ma femme à mes pieds, elle priait et pensait que je dormais. Je commençais par poser des questions aux gens leur demandant depuis quand ils étaient là et presqu'unanimement ils repondait presqu'une heure. Et je me mettais à leur raconter avec des larmes depuis quand j'étais parti et je nome voulais pas y revenir su ce n'était ce souffle violent de ce mysterieux personnage qui poussait. Dès lors, j'ai réalisé que la distance de cette vie à la vie d'après est infiniment petite et la jouissance d'après n'est aucunement comparable à ce que nous appellons bonheur ici-bas. Et qu'il est plus qu'un privilège d'aimer, de pardonner tant qu'on peut car on peut ne jamais avoir cette opportunité. Quatre mois après soit le 28 Août 2023, je suis opéré du foie et je vis merveilleusement bien après la greffe hépatique. Gloire à Yeshua Amashia Kuhmama et merci aux médecins et à la famille du donneur. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: April 14, 2023 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Illness Surgery-related. Life threatening event, but not clinical death. I was suffered of Liver disease stage 4 due to Wilson disease How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely distressing Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I Heard this mysterious person halo, voices, and presence. I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Less consciousness and alertness than normal. I was unconscious until I came back to my body At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? No consciousness Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Were your senses More vivid than usual? More vivid than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. It was indescribable Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I could hear a pin drop Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Uncertain. It was so quick I don't even have a way to describe it Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes Brighter than any light; pure Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? A clearly mystical or unearthly realm What emotions did you feel during the experience? Total peace, joy, love, and living life to the fullest Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Christian- Protestant Good has favored me because of what HE HAS planned from before I even been born Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Christian- Protestant As of for me and my family, we will serve the LORD Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. There is a God above Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? Yes During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? Yes This mysterious person halo and presence welcomed me exactly like it is described in the bible Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Uncertain I just felt that nothing worths love, peace, and harmony while you can on this earth. However, if you missed it you will regret it During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? Yes. The indescribable joy, peace, and love that is there, does not let you remember the life you've been living Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes The presence of the mysterious person expresses love in whole dimension What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Large changes in my life. Become more faithful and grateful to Yeshua Amashiah Kumahma Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? I try to live humbly After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. At the time, I was pushed back to my body by that divine breath. I was strangely gathered around with the people around asking weird questions. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain. I just have some dreams no like others Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? Yes, I had some predictions Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes 1 year Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real. After my Liver transplant surgery for me to come out of the coma, I had to experience another NDE again What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Yes After my medical procedure Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? Not at the moment. Thank you nojtr7q_nde
